commit.message:
Header, footer and banner from the design system

overrides/main.html is generated again (make_arxiv_theme/prep_for_mkdocs.sh): a plain
Jinja script renders the design system's arxiv-brand-templates into the mkdocs-material
override, with the hosts and the asset route left as mkdocs expressions, in place of the
hand-copied arxiv-base chrome. extra.css takes the shared header's tokens and keeps the bar
52px tall around material's search.

The banner shows the design system's shared announcements, and the footer is the design system's.

CSS, fonts, scripts and images load from the design-system asset route, BRAND_STATIC_BASE
(production when unset; the develop and PR builds set the dev route). To update, run
./make_arxiv_theme/prep_for_mkdocs.sh and commit the override.

overrides/main.html: generated from design-system b82af76ecc4a.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit.message:
Add real funder logos to Major Funders page

Replace the placeholder logos with the logos for Schmidt Sciences,
Siegel Family Endowment, Simons Foundation International and XTX Markets.
Logo alt text is empty because each funder's name appears as text
directly below its logo.

Known issues, not yet fixed:
- The Schmidt Sciences and XTX image files have a lot of empty space,
  so those logos look smaller than the others.
- In dark mode, the Schmidt Sciences text is hard to see and the XTX logo
  shows as a white square.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add draft Major Funders page with logo card styles

New page source/about/major_funders.md, copied from supporters.md, with
funders shown as two-column cards: logo centered above the funder name.
Logos are placeholders for now.

New classes in extra.css:
- mkd-logo-blocks: stacks a list block's logo above its text
- mkd-blocks-spacious: more padding and height for featured list blocks
- mkd-funder-logo: sets every funder logo to 60px tall; a logo too wide
  for its card scales down inside the same box

The page is not yet in SUMMARY.md, and its heading still reads
"Our Supporters".

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
